Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Tampa Opens The Breeze: A Smoke-Free Experience By Hard Rock Following $30 Million Casino Resort Transformation

TAMPA, Fla. (November 19, 2026) – Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Tampa today celebrated the grand opening of The Breeze: A Smoke-Free Experience by Hard Rock. Developed in response to guest feedback, the transformative $30 million expansion of the resort’s smoke-free offerings is designed intentionally for guests who prefer the option of a smoke-free environment from the moment they arrive until the moment they leave.

“Guests told us they wanted more smoke-free options, and we took that feedback to heart,” said Travis Lunn, president of Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Tampa. “We invested $30 million to create an experience guests could feel from the moment they arrive, whether they’re here to play, meet friends for dinner or spend the weekend.”

Extending beyond gaming, the experience begins at valet and extends through the hotel lobby, restaurants, bars, gaming areas, spa and pool amenities, delivering a seamless smoke-free journey throughout the resort. 

The Breeze features over 2,800 slot machines and 80 table games across smoke-free gaming areas that include the Mezzanine Level, Hard Rock Event Center, Pool Bar & Grill and the casino floor between L Bar and Cipresso. The meticulous renovation included new carpeting, chairs, gaming table felts and ceiling treatments.        

There are seven smoke-free dining and bar venues which include L Bar, Cipresso, Constant Grind, The Rez Grill, Sugar Factory, Rise Kitchen & Deli and Pool Bar & Grill.

The smoke-free experience also includes the hotel, retail stores, pool, Rock Spa® & Salon, Hard Rock Sportsbook, box office, bell desk and a new Player’s Club.

The Breeze showcases all new memorabilia from Taylor Swift, Miranda Lambert, Miley Cyrus, Madonna, Olivia Rodrigo, Sabrina Carpenter, Chappell Roan, Britney Spears, Ariana Grande, Katy Perry, Rihanna, Elton John, Imagine Dragons and more.

Beyond The Breeze, guests can enjoy additional smoke-free table games and poker tables in The Draper Room and slot machines in the Hard Rock Cafe.

Seminole Hard Rock Tampa gives guests the freedom to choose the environment that best suits their preferences, with designated smoking areas remaining available throughout the property.

As part of The Breeze’s grand opening celebration, Seminole Hard Rock Tampa presented $50,000 each to The Florida Aquarium, Ronald McDonald House Tampa Bay, Julie Weintraub’s Hands Across The Bay and Keep Tampa Bay Beautiful. The donations are part of Seminole Hard Rock Tampa’s ongoing investment in the Tampa Bay community by supporting local organizations that serve people and our planet.

For more information, visit casino.hardrock.com/tampa/casino/smoke-free.

About Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Tampa
Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Tampa is central Florida’s premier gaming, entertainment, and hospitality destination. Owned by the Seminole Tribe of Florida, the fully integrated AAA Four-Diamond-rated resort features an expansive casino, including live blackjack, baccarat, craps, roulette, and more. Sports enthusiasts can enjoy the thrill of wagering at dozens of retail sports betting locations, with both electronic kiosks and staffed betting windows. The Breeze: A Smoke-Free Experience by Hard Rock offers guests the option of a completely smoke-free resort experience from arrival to departure, including valet, lobby areas, restaurants, bars, gaming, spa and pool amenities, giving guests more choice, greater comfort and an elevated way to enjoy the resort. Poker fans can experience the game in an electrifying yet convenient, smoke-free environment at The Draper Room, located just steps from the Draper Place Garage. The Draper Room features 44 poker tables, 12 live table games, a dedicated cashier, restrooms, and a full-service snack bar with cocktail service. Exclusive high-limit and VIP areas further enhance the resort’s state-of-the-art gaming options. Hard Rock Event Center is operating as a temporary, 24-hour smoke-free gaming destination with 682 all-new slot machines and 34 table games. The luxury resort provides an elevated getaway experience with over 800 smoke-free guest rooms across two hotel towers, a sprawling 60,000-square-foot pool deck boasting three pools and 19 private cabanas, and more premium amenities such as the rejuvenating Rock Spa® & Salon. Guests can indulge in a diverse culinary scene spanning 15 food and beverage offerings, including the award-winning Council Oak Steaks & Seafood, The Rez Grill, Cipresso, and guest favorites Fresh Harvest Buffet and Hard Rock Cafe. The brand’s iconic music heritage is celebrated throughout the resort with unique memorabilia and artwork paying homage to some of the world's most renowned contemporary musical artists. As one of Tampa Bay’s largest employers with nearly 4,300 team members, Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Tampa is conveniently located near the intersection of I-4 and I-75, at North Orient Road and Hillsborough Avenue, just 10 minutes east of downtown Tampa. For more information, please call 866-388-GAME, visit us online and follow us on Facebook, X and Instagram.

About Hard Rock®

Hard Rock International (HRI) is one of the most globally recognized companies with venues in nearly 80 countries spanning more than 300 venues including owned/licensed or managed Hotels, Casinos, Rock Shops®, Live Performance Locations and Cafes. Beginning with an Eric Clapton guitar, Hard Rock owns the world's largest and most valuable collection of authentic music memorabilia with more than 89,000 pieces displayed at locations around the globe. The Unity™ by Hard Rock global loyalty program rewards members for doing the things they love across participating properties. In addition, Hard Rock Digital spotlights the sports betting and iGaming experience with products remixed in the spirit of Hard Rock for players worldwide. HRI has received numerous industry, destination and workplace awards across the travel, hospitality, gaming, entertainment and food & beverage sectors. HRI currently holds investment grades from primary investment-grade rating agencies: S&P Global Ratings (BBB), Moody's Investors Service (Baa2), and Fitch Ratings (BBB). For more information on Hard Rock International, visit www.hardrock.com or shop.hardrock.com.

Hard Rock International Rings in the Holidays With Hotel Getaways, Live Entertainment, Limited-Time Gifts, Seasonal Menus and More

Photo 1: Hard Rock Hotel Madrid. Guests who book Hard Rock Hotel stays from Nov. 12 to Dec. 6 will receive up to 25% off at participating city and resort hotels and up to 55% off at participating all-inclusive hotels worldwide for stays Dec. 20, 2026, through May 31, 2027.

Photo 2: From Dec. 1 through Dec. 31, Hard Rock Cafe guests can enjoy a limited-time holiday menu featuring Pecan-Crusted Salmon, Braised Short Rib, Herb-Roasted Chicken, along with Sticky Toffee Bread Pudding, a Pumpkin Spice Espresso Martini and the Rosemary Pomegranate Refresher.

Additional images

HOLLYWOOD, Fla., Nov. 12, 2026 -- Hard Rock International is amplifying the holiday spirit with seasonal experiences and offerings across Hard Rock Hotels, Casinos, Cafes, Rock Shops®, and Hard Rock Digital platforms. From hotel booking deals to festive dining and limited-edition merchandise including exclusive items featuring The Rolling Stones, Hard Rock invites guests and fans to celebrate the holidays at its destinations around the world.

“We’re excited to bring people together for another holiday season filled with the music, energy and experiences that make Hard Rock legendary,” said Jeff Hook, Chief Operating Officer at Hard Rock International. “From bucket-list stays and celebratory meals to live shows and exciting games, our holiday lineup offers something for every kind of fan to make the season their own."

Hard Rock Hotels

Hard Rock has a holiday getaway for every traveler, whether you’re dreaming of an alpine escape in Switzerland, exploring Malta’s waterfront and historic charm, or trading snow for sand on beaches from the Caribbean to Bali. For those with a New York City trip on their wish list, the award-winning Hard Rock Hotel New York puts you in the heart of the action. From festive décor to live music, Hard Rock Hotels and REVERB by Hard Rock® hotels around the globe make the season memorable.

For a gift that keeps on giving, the holiday travel sale runs Nov. 12 through Dec. 6. The sale covers stays from Dec. 20, 2026, through May 31, 2027. Direct bookings on the Hard Rock Hotels website can save up to 25% at participating city and resort hotels, and up to 55% off on all-inclusive resort hotels - in addition to other perks like a $200 daily resort credit, kids-stay-free benefits and round-trip airport transportation. Unity™ by Hard Rock loyalty program members can unlock even more travel savings and exclusive benefits.

Hard Rock Casinos & Hard Rock Live

Hard Rock Casinos deck the halls for the holidays, offering many ways to celebrate the season in style with great dining, fun games and, of course, a dazzling lineup of entertainment. For music, entertainment and comedy enthusiasts, live experiences - and the memories made together - are the best gifts money can buy this holiday season. Hard Rock Live venues are hosting concerts and shows including:

  • Marcello Hernández at Hard Rock Live Hollywood, Fla.
  • Earth, Wind & Fire at Hard Rock Live Atlantic City, N.J.
  • Lady A: This Winter’s Night Tour 2026 at Hard Rock Live in Gary, Ind.
  • Maroon 5 at Hard Rock Live Hollywood, Fla.
  • Derek Hough Dance for the Holidays at Hard Rock Live venues in Bristol, Va. and Rockford, Ill.

Visit casino.hardrock.com and entertainment.hardrock.com to learn more about these and other offerings.

Rock Shops

Just in time for holiday gifting, Hard Rock is rolling out a lineup of limited-edition merchandise designed to bring festive style to fans around the world. Available now, the collection includes a holiday-themed t-shirt and sweatshirt, as well as collectible ornaments and pins perfect for commemorating the season. In December, Hard Rock will introduce an exclusive collection featuring The Rolling Stones including two limited-edition unisex t-shirts. Fans can also look forward to the launch of the new Diamond Tee in mid-November, adding another standout piece to this season's assortment. Merchandise will be available at participating Hard Rock locations and online.

For gift ideas, fans can browse Hard Rock's online Holiday Gift Guide from Nov. 8 through Dec. 25. Throughout the holiday shopping season, guests can enjoy special promotions and seasonal offers with discounts of up to 50% off select merchandise. Offers and product availability may vary by location and sales channel. Visit shop.hardrock.com to find a nearby Rock Shop® or shop online.

Hard Rock Cafes

Thanksgiving: Whether it's at your place or ours, Hard Rock Cafe is helping guests celebrate the season together. On Thursday, Nov. 26, Hard Rock Cafes across North America and Europe will serve a Legendary Thanksgiving dinner featuring roasted turkey breast with cranberry and gravy, green bean casserole, sweet potato mash topped with toasted marshmallow, and buttermilk stuffing with Gruyère and sage. To round out the meal, guests can add Sticky Toffee Bread Pudding and a Pumpkin Spice Espresso Martini or the Rosemary Pomegranate Refresher mocktail which continue throughout the 2026 holiday season.

Hosting at home, at the office or for Friendsgiving? Thanksgiving catering is available at 37 participating Cafes across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East. At participating U.S. Cafes, choose from a Small Dinner that feeds four to five people, or a Large Dinner that feeds 10 to 12 guests. Sticky Toffee Bread Pudding can be added as dessert. Place catering orders at least 24 hours in advance, with a final ordering cutoff of Wednesday, Nov. 25, for Thanksgiving Day.

Holidays: The festive flavors continue at Hard Rock Cafes Dec. 1 through Dec. 31, when guests can Celebrate the Holiday Hits with a limited-time holiday menu featuring Pecan-Crusted Salmon, Braised Short Rib and Herb-Roasted Chicken, special dessert and cocktails.

Hard Rock Cafes make a fantastic venue for corporate and personal celebrations, and December dates are filling fast. Book a Hard Rock Cafe event for 30 or more guests by Nov. 30 and choose a perk to make the celebration extra special: complimentary group welcome drinks, or live entertainment to get everyone on their feet. Perks are available at participating Cafes and subject to availability. Local events teams are ready to work with you on the rest of the details.

Holiday visitors to London can also stop by Hard Rock Cafe Piccadilly Circus, now home to a Build-A-Bear Workshop experience, the first brand partner store inside a Hard Rock Cafe, where guests can make their own furry friend dressed in a mini version of Hard Rock’s iconic London tee or hoodie for a one-of-a-kind souvenir to bring home.

Visit cafe.hardrock.com to find your nearest Cafe and event listings.

Hard Rock Bet

Hard Rock Bet is celebrating the season with Winterfest promotions running Dec. 1, 2026 through Jan. 3, 2027 featuring seasonal games, offers, and rewards for eligible players. Sports fans can also enjoy 12 daily offers from Dec. 23, 2026 through Jan. 3, 2027 coinciding with NFL, NBA, and college football action over the holidays. Offers, rewards, and eligibility vary by market. Learn more by visiting the Hard Rock Bet app.

Hard Rock Games

Hard Rock Games is celebrating the holiday season with festive giveaways and special offers across its game portfolio. November brings “Feast of Fortune,” a daily cash giveaway, alongside Thanksgiving, Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals. The festivities continue in December with “Holly Jolly Jackpots,” a month-long cash giveaway, plus daily giveaways, sales and more. Adding to the holiday excitement, players can spin the wheel in a sweet $1 million Candy Land-themed giveaway Dec. 15 to 17. Registration is open now through Dec. 17 in Jackpot Planet or Neverland Casino. Terms and conditions apply.
